content.title: Evercore downgrades QuantumScape as auto revenue shifts toward 2029–2031
content.summary: Investing.com -- Evercore ISI downgraded QuantumScape to In Line, saying the battery developer’s sharp rally and a later-than-expected auto revenue timeline leave limited near term upside. The move comes as the bank shifts its entire autos coverage to 2027 based valuation frameworks, which it says point to more than 20% sector upside over the next year.
